finclear_secops: Hi team — FINCLEAR SecOps. We're filling out the SIG/CAIQ but hit two blockers: 1) our auditors expect a line-delimited JSONL 'audit.log' export and the sample in docs looks nested. Can you provide the exact JSONL sample your export tool produces? 2) When pulling evidence via the /v1/exports API we're intermittently getting 401s for some object keys which prevents us from packaging artifacts. Deadline for submission is Fri 2024-09-06. Can we get an extension if this isn't resolved? (ticket FC-3421)

elaine_support: Thanks — noted. Can you paste the curl you used and a truncated response body + any x-request-id header values? Also confirm which org ID (last 4 chars) and whether you're on Hosted or Dedicated.

finclear_secops: Hosted. Org: fc9b. Here's the curl and response we captured:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports/ev_abc123/download
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
x-request-id: req-0a1b2c3d
{
  "error": "unauthorized",
  "message": "invalid or expired token"
}
```
We also saw some calls return 500 with body "encrypted_key not found" when retrying.

sanjay_se: @elaine_support raising to eng — can you capture the exact request ids and timestamps (we need them to correlate in logs). Also, if this is Hosted, KMS token lifecycle matters. @finclear_secops are these export jobs long-running (>10m) or short? That helps reproduce.

finclear_secops: Exports are long-running, often 20–45m for large windows.

julia_security: For the SIG: if you require HSM attestation we can attach the HSM cert bundle (PKCS7) and a statement of signing. Question: do auditors need plaintext logs or is hashed/pseudonymized accepted? That affects retention detail in the form.

finclear_secops: Auditors want full event JSONL (no redaction) for a 90-day window. They also want proof keys are KMS-managed.

mike_infra: Thanks — I think we're hitting a token refresh race when the export process re-uses a short-lived session token. Short-term workaround: use a fresh export API key per job or force token refresh before each download attempt. Example small helper (run server-side):
```
# minimal node-ish pseudo
async function fetchExport(url, apiKey) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' } });
  if (res.status === 401) {
    // refresh logic
    await refreshSessionToken();
    return fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` } });
  }
  return res;
}
```
I'll add a temporary script to the ticket that streams JSONL with single-line events.

elaine_support: @mike_infra please attach the sample JSONL line for FC-3421. Also @finclear_secops we will request a 2-week extension from the audit contact and confirm back once approved. Can you hold off on re-running until we post the sample and the workaround? :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: Ticket created: FC-3421. Severity: High. Teams: CS / SE / Infra / Security. Linked PRs/tickets will be appended.

mike_infra: Sample JSONL line (single-line event) — copying below:
```
{"ts":"2024-08-01T12:03:21Z","event":"api.request","org_id":"fc9b","user":"u-1234","request_id":"req-0a1b2c3d","path":"/v1/embeddings","status":200,"details":{"model":"rw-large","tokens":42}}
```

finclear_secops: Got it — trying the workaround now. Will report results here. Appreciate the extension ask.

elaine_support: Follow-up: extension request submitted to the auditor (awaiting reply). We'll update FC-3421 with logs once eng confirms mitigation. Thanks everyone.

finclear_secops: Thanks — one more: can you include in the export evidence that keys are KMS-managed (key id + create date)? Auditor asked for KMS key metadata for export bundle.

julia_security: We can include a signed metadata file with key_id, key_type (KMS/HSM), created_at, and an attestation statement. I'll add a template to the ticket.

mike_infra: Noted — attaching metadata template into FC-3421 now.

finclear_secops: Perfect — will wait for the artifacts. :pray:
